sources: UNEP / UNU Global E-Waste Monitor - Material Flow & Composition Benchmarks
EMPA (Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Science) WEEE PCB Fraction Characterization
European Union RoHS Directive (2011/65/EU & 2015/863 Annex II) & WEEE Directive (2012/19/EU)
reference_metadata.scientific_limitation_notice: CRITICAL LIMITATION: Standard RGB 2D computer vision identifies visible exterior shapes and component packaging. It cannot perform chemical spectrometry, X-ray fluorescence (XRF), or mass spectrometry. The values provided below are statistical reference estimates derived from empirical laboratory disassembly studies of corresponding board classifications. They are decision-support estimates and MUST NOT be construed as certified laboratory measurements.

motherboard.description: Multi-layer high-density PCB with multiple chipset sockets, expansion slots, and extensive copper grounding planes.

hazardous_substances.name: Brominated Flame Retardants (BFRs / TBBPA)
hazardous_substances.source_location: FR-4 epoxy resin substrate & connector housing
hazardous_substances.hazard_profile: Persistent organic pollutant potential; toxic dioxin/furan release during uncontrolled combustion

hazardous_substances.name: Lead (Pb) Compounds
hazardous_substances.source_location: Solder joints (legacy non-RoHS boards) and internal IC packaging termination
hazardous_substances.hazard_profile: Neurotoxic heavy metal; bioaccumulative in soil and aquatic runoff

hazardous_substances.name: Beryllium (Be)
hazardous_substances.source_location: Beryllium-copper alloy in spring contact connectors and socket pins
hazardous_substances.hazard_profile: Carcinogenic via particulate inhalation during mechanical shredding

hazardous_substances.name: Capacitor Electrolytes
hazardous_substances.source_location: Electrolytic capacitor canisters (ethylene glycol, butyrolactone, boric acid)
hazardous_substances.hazard_profile: Corrosive / irritant liquid; requires manual depollution prior to shredding

handling_recommendations: Depollute large electrolytic capacitors and lithium coin cell batteries prior to shredding.
Desolder reusable processor sockets and memory interfaces using temperature-controlled hot air (max 245°C).
Send stripped FR-4 resin substrate to authorized pyrometallurgical copper smelter with acid-gas scrubbers.

graphics_card.description: High-density multi-layer board with large GPU die, GDDR high-speed VRAM, and high-current voltage regulator modules (VRMs).

hazardous_substances.name: Lead (Pb) & Trace Heavy Metals
hazardous_substances.source_location: Underfill solder balls (BGA) and legacy solder fillets

hazardous_substances.name: Electrolytic Solvents
hazardous_substances.source_location: Solid polymer and aluminum capacitors in power phases

handling_recommendations: Disassemble aluminum/copper heatsink before component harvesting to maximize scrap purity.
Inspect high-value GDDR memory ICs and VRM MOSFETs for secondary repair demand.
Channel substrate to specialized e-waste precious metal refiners.

controller_board.description: 2-to-4 layer microcontroller board (e.g., appliance controller, router, automation gateway) with moderate component density.

hazardous_content_percentage.regulatory_risk: Low-Moderate (Generally RoHS compliant in modern models)

hazardous_substances.name: Flame Retardants (TBBPA)
hazardous_substances.hazard_profile: Ecotoxic to aquatic life under landfill leaching

hazardous_substances.name: Lead (Trace)
hazardous_substances.source_location: Older connector headers or uncertified solder

handling_recommendations: High percentage of reusable MCUs and I/O headers; prioritize desoldering for maker education.
Check EEPROM/Flash chips for configuration wipe before reuse.
Sort remaining FR-4 board into general electronic scrap stream.

power_supply_board.description: Single or double-sided board with heavy iron-core transformers, large high-voltage filter capacitors, and power semiconductors.

hazardous_content_percentage.regulatory_risk: High (Contains large electrolytic fluid volume & heavy solder)

hazardous_substances.name: Electrolytic Fluid / Solvents
hazardous_substances.hazard_profile: High volume of organic solvent / acid electrolyte; leak and fire hazard

hazardous_substances.name: Brominated Flame Retardants & Varnishes
hazardous_substances.source_location: Substrate and potting resins / transformer insulating tape

hazardous_substances.name: Lead / Heavy Solder
hazardous_substances.source_location: Through-hole wave solder baths with thicker alloy fillets

handling_recommendations: SAFETY MANDATE: Ensure all primary high-voltage capacitors (>100V) are safely discharged with a resistor load before physical contact.
Recover aluminum heatsinks and copper transformer windings mechanically.
Depollute large capacitors as separate hazardous waste stream under WEEE guidelines.

unknown.description: Unclassified electronic circuit board without verified operating domain or mass reference.
unknown.reason_insufficient: Optical RGB photographs alone cannot determine alloy thickness, substrate laminate composition, or internal hazardous chemical mass fraction without board category classification or physical weight measurement.
required_tests: Handheld X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) spectrometry for heavy metal detection (Pb, Cd, Hg, Cr-VI, Br)
Board classification selection (Motherboard, GPU, Controller, Power Supply)
Gravimetric scale weighing (grams) to calculate mass fraction percentage
unknown.regulatory_risk: Indeterminate - Default to precautionary hazardous e-waste containment
